omnichat.custom.apiKeyRequired.description: Whether the custom endpoint requires an API key (stored in SecretStorage, never in settings).
omnichat.custom.apiKeyRequired.title: API key required

omnichat.custom.baseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp server, ...).
omnichat.custom.baseUrl.title: Custom endpoint base URL

omnichat.custom.model.description: Default model id for the custom endpoint, used when the endpoint has no model list.
omnichat.custom.model.title: Custom endpoint model

omnichat.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server.
omnichat.ollama.baseUrl.title: Ollama base URL

omnichat.ollama.model.description: Ollama model id to chat with (e.g. qwen3:8b). Pick from the model switcher.
omnichat.ollama.model.title: Ollama model

omnichat.openrouter.model.description: OpenRouter model id to chat with.
omnichat.openrouter.model.title: OpenRouter model

enumDescriptions: Run models locally via Ollama. Private: nothing leaves your machine.
Use OpenRouter's cloud API. Requires an API key; prompts leave your machine.
Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp server, ...).
omnichat.provider.title: Provider

omnichat.requestTimeout.description: Seconds without receiving a token before a request is treated as stalled and cancelled.
omnichat.requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (seconds)

description: The simplest private AI assistant for VS Code. Chat with local models via Ollama, frontier models via OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, right inside your editor. Guided setup, selection context, and one-click code insertion.
name: omnichat-ai-vscode-ext

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ee2
